landing.heroLead: Pick a dragon, a flight time, and book in a minute.
landing.bridgeLead: Still choosing? How booking works, where pickup is, and how to reach us — briefly on the about page.
landing.howLead: Four steps from catalog to flight — no password, no long forms.
landing.howStep1Body: Twenty dragons in the catalog: tags, hourly rate, and a short blurb.
landing.howStep2Body: See right away if the slot is free and what the fare will be.
landing.howStep3Body: We send a six-digit code — no password needed.
landing.howStep4Body: Pay the manager on site. The booking is already in your cabinet.
landing.trustLead: Online booking with no double slots and clear pay-on-arrival.
landing.trustItem1Body: Pick and book in a minute — no messenger back-and-forth.
landing.trustItem2Body: The system will not let anyone take a time that is already taken.
landing.trustItem3Body: Booking lives in your cabinet; you pay the manager at pickup.
landing.aboutLead: Drakonsk is a small shop: twenty dragons and live pickup at the cottage on the meadow.
landing.aboutBody: We help match a dragon to the job — from a first stroll to a photoshoot — and keep the schedule honest: one booking, one slot. Open from {{open}} to {{close}}.
landing.placeAddress: Meadow by the pond, red-roof cottage, Drakonsk
landing.placeHow: Landmarks as on the map: path to the rental cottage, pond with reeds on the left, fence with a flag on the right. Pickup point is at the cottage entrance.
landing.placeArrive: Arrive a little early: a manager will check your booking in the cabinet, show the dragon, and go over flight rules. Park by the fence, then walk the path to the red roof.
landing.placeTip: If you get lost, call or email us using the contacts below — we will guide you by the map landmarks.
landing.placeMapAlt: Pixel map of the rental place: cottage, pond, path, and pickup pin
